beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Imagine a model travelling with a record of where it deserves trust.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book proposes recording assumptions, purposes, resources, errors, and conditions for renewed validation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The point is to keep a useful result attached to its limits.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A model developed for one population may require scrutiny before another use.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A descriptive score may require different justification when it becomes a coercive decision.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its numerical accuracy could remain unchanged while its authority becomes inappropriate.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That connection between validity and permission is especially distinctive in this book.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed record makes the boundary an object of inquiry, rather than a footnote.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The author pictures knowledge as an ecology of models that can correct each other.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This does not mean collecting viewpoints without testing their claims against reality.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Different instruments can converge, predictions can fail, and evidence can resist our preferences.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The challenge is to make translation between models explicit enough to inspect.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Executable science is one proposed way of preserving those relationships computationally.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A theory would carry more than equations copied away from methods and assumptions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reading these chapters connects philosophical limits to practical structures for scientific knowledge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their promise remains a research direction whose value must be demonstrated.
